old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-4r6x","title":"Node receive timeout accepts values that defeat timer progress or spin the receive loop","description":"Security review of python/src/lichen/node.py found Node.__post_init__ does not validate NodeConfig.receive_timeout_ms, while set_config coerces bool/float/string values with int() and imposes no upper bound.
